content.comment_body: Can anyone explain the capabilities of the [product_name] Communication Interface Module in slave mode? I noticed there isn’t an option to configure a Data Transfer Table as there is in master mode.
The [product_name] Communication Interface Module allows only one Modbus RTU connection, either as a single slave or as a master.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking about the functionality of the [product_name] Communication Interface Module when set to slave mode, focusing on configuration differences from master mode. The response highlights a key limitation—the module only supports one Modbus RTU connection at a time, and the absence of a Data Transfer Table in slave mode appears to be an intentional design limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for configuration capabilities in slave mode similar to those in master mode, such as managing multiple Modbus RTU slave connections and having access to a Data Transfer Table.
pain_keywords: no data transfer table in slave mode
